title: JSFL API expansion: frames, layers, scripts, properties, library, convertToSymbol
description: Parallel to the agent MCP work (docs/19-agent-interface.md §Implementation plan step 4; docs/18 Layer 4). Grow packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts from the current minimal surface (addNewRectangle/addNewOval/addNewText/selectAll/addNewLayer) toward Flash 8's documented JSFL DOM so the jsfl_run MCP tool is a genuinely useful escape hatch for agents: timeline.insertFrames/removeFrames/convertToKeyframes/convertToBlankKeyframes/createMotionTween/setFrameProperty, layer CRUD + properties (deleteLayer, setLayerProperty: name/locked/visible/type), timeline.currentLayer/setSelectedLayers, frame.actionScript get/set (maps to setFrameScript), document property setters (width/height/frameRate/backgroundColor), document.convertToSymbol(type,name,registration), library access (library.items, addNewItem, deleteItem, item renaming), document.setSelectionRect/selection assignment, document.deleteSelection, document.publish() returning bytes, fl.trace. Use ruffle and Flash 8 JSFL docs as reference for exact method names/signatures — accuracy first. All mutations must flow through @flash/core mutation functions on the runtime state so finalDocument lands in history. Reset any module-level counters between runs (see CLAUDE.md learnings on shared mutable state). Tests: extend apps/desktop/e2e/jsfl.spec.ts plus authoring-ui unit tests for each new API group.
